editorial_thesis: Frontier capacity only matters when it becomes bounded, reviewable practice: benchmark the model, govern the rollout, prove delivery, and learn in public.

topic_groups.title: Frontier models become long-horizon work engines
topic_groups.selection_rationale: A material model update earns inclusion because it changes the practical envelope for coding, document work, and cyber workflows; it is distinct from yesterday’s lower-cost model economics.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon
sources.why_selected: One-million-token context and long-horizon coding/document/cyber positioning.
sources.usefulness: Benchmark a long-lived Buildn task with cached context, review gates, and cost telemetry.

sources.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash and Flash Cyber
sources.why_selected: A lighter model family signals a portfolio approach for agentic workflows and cyber work.
sources.usefulness: Use a cheap routing tier for extraction, triage, and evidence preparation.

sources.title: Gemini Computer Use model
sources.why_selected: Browser and mobile interaction remains a separate risk surface from reasoning.
sources.usefulness: Keep computer-use actions behind presence checks, screenshots, and reversible steps.

topic_groups.title: Public-sector AI enters an adoption window
topic_groups.selection_rationale: October 1 is a concrete start date for a broad government offer, creating an unusually actionable procurement and enablement signal rather than another abstract policy story.

sources.title: OpenAI + GSA public-sector agreement
sources.why_selected: The 27-month offer begins October 1 and includes broader eligibility, discounted usage, and Daybreak Blue.
sources.usefulness: Use the structure as a checklist for governed rollout: eligibility, spend, training, and data policy.

sources.title: Daybreak for Frontline Defenders
sources.why_selected: The offer is part of a larger cyber-defense support program.
sources.usefulness: Separate subsidized defensive use from general-purpose deployment in client proposals.

sources.title: OpenAI cyber access
sources.why_selected: Shows the surrounding trust and access model for advanced defensive capability.
sources.usefulness: Map verification and abuse controls before adopting high-impact cyber workflows.

topic_groups.title: AI services are being productized around proof
topic_groups.selection_rationale: The partner signal is older than today but materially useful as a market structure: production deployments, certified practitioners, and public references become visible proof points for services firms.

sources.title: Claude Partner Network Services Track
sources.why_selected: Anthropic publishes tier requirements around certified practitioners, production customers, and references.
sources.usefulness: Use the metrics as a design brief for a small, credible implementation practice.

sources.title: Claude partner program
sources.why_selected: The partner surface connects customers to firms with stated implementation capability.
sources.usefulness: Study how proof is presented and what evidence a Buildn offer should expose.

sources.title: Claude certification
sources.why_selected: Individual certification is part of the services-track measurement system.
sources.usefulness: Treat learning as an operating capability with recency and deployment evidence.

topic_groups.title: Hands-on agent building gets a global distribution channel
topic_groups.selection_rationale: DevFest opens today with 800+ local events, offering a practical learning and client-signal channel that has been under-covered in recent dossiers.

sources.title: DevFest 2026
sources.why_selected: The season runs October 1–December 31 with 800+ events in 115 countries.
sources.usefulness: Use the event directory to identify practical local signal and workshop topics.

sources.title: DevFest event directory
sources.why_selected: The directory is the actionable index for local events.
sources.usefulness: Find one event with a relevant agent, security, or Firebase track.

sources.title: Google Antigravity
sources.why_selected: DevFest names Antigravity among the hands-on technologies for the agentic era.
sources.usefulness: Compare its workflow assumptions with Hermes and Buildn patterns.
